title: Ferran Torres Delivers on Soccer's Biggest Stage Wearing Under Armour
summary: Under Armour athlete Ferran Torres etched his name into soccer history in the UA Shadow Elite 4 FG Mach, scoring the lone goal of the 2026 FIFA World Cup Final to lift Spain to a 1-0 victory against Argentina. He found the breakthrough in the 106th minute of extra time, delivering the decisive strike that secured Spain's second-ever world title.
body_markdown:
As the world watched, Torres scored the difference-making goal wearing the **Under Armour Shadow Elite 4 Mach FG Cleat** . Engineered for explosive movement, agility and control, the Shadow Elite 4 is designed to help players create separation when the pressure is highest. Its standout performance features include:


### Ultra-lightweight construction


Weighing just 213 grams, making it one of the lightest football boots on the market.


### Carbon fiber outsole


with strategically placed bladed studs, engineered for explosive acceleration, controlled deceleration and precise changes of direction.


### Micro Warp Upper


For directional lock out, limited stretch & dynamic response


### 3D haptic micro-texture


across the striking zone to enhance ball contact in both wet and dry conditions.


### 3D heel reinforcement


that minimizes internal foot slippage during sprints and sharp cuts.
